patterns.note: Asymmetrical arrangement of image and text blocks, often with full-bleed images, creating dynamic visual interest and an editorial feel.
A highly expressive, handwritten script font is used for prominent display text, contrasting with a classic serif for headings and a clean sans-serif for body copy.
A dominant, vibrant red is used as a full-bleed background in key sections, providing a bold brand statement and high contrast with black and white text.
A subscription modal appears as a persistent, fixed-position overlay, remaining visible and interactive in the viewport as the user scrolls the underlying page content.

technique_notes: A fixed-position overlay (modal/popup) is used to present a subscription form, remaining visible and interactive while the user scrolls the underlying page content, effectively creating a persistent call to action.
The hero section utilizes a full-bleed, solid vibrant color background combined with an oversized, custom-designed script typeface for the main title, creating an immediate and strong brand identity.
Content sections are often introduced with large, impactful imagery and asymmetrical text blocks, breaking away from rigid grid layouts to foster an editorial and artistic feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, expressive display headings (~4-5x body) with a handwritten character, complemented by traditional serif headings (~2x body) and a clean sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and input fields within modals; otherwise, sharp corners for most content blocks and images.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within text blocks, creating a comfortable reading experience, while artwork grids are more compact.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold, almost rebellious use of a vibrant, full-bleed red background combined with an oversized, handwritten display typeface in the hero section. This immediately conveys a strong artistic personality and sets an unconventional, editorial tone that differentiates it from typical gallery sites.
